texts: mixed: the questioning, its participants, 'at the Watch', Year 1 and the two-days-before-the-equinox anchor all come through, but 'in the late summer' is dropped entirely - a season has no time carrier for us unless it is a speech-anchored deictic like 'last spring'. Rewrite as: 'In Year 1, during the late summer, two days before the autumn equinox, the Council questioned Coraline Ash at the Watch.' - 'during' is one of the three words that nest one period inside another, so the season becomes a real period the questioning sits inside instead of being dropped, while Year 1 keeps its own slot on the event.

good. the duration attaches to the same questioning event introduced in the previous sentence, so no content is lost. The one residue is that 'afternoon' is not a unit we can convert, so a cross-unit question ('did it run more than two hours?') will not resolve - and no rewrite fixes that without inventing an hour figure you never stated.

mixed: the reported speech itself is handled well - the claim stays sealed under the saying, the village and both compound kinds project out, and 'that year' picks up Year 1 - but two things wobble. The speaker's symbol came out as 'vesh', dropping the capitalized 'Old' that is part of the name, so a second character named Vesh would collide with him; that slip is ours to fix, not yours. 'A Keeper family' is a capitalized common noun sitting in front of a common noun, a shape our instruction set does not decide, so one run can fuse it into a single kind and another can split it into a family plus a separate Keeper. Rewrite as: 'Old Vesh said that the village lacked an apprentice candidate from a keeper family that year.' - lowercasing 'keeper' makes it an ordinary compound kind and removes the fork.
good. 'by a vote' lands as the means, and 'as an apprentice' comes out as a result state plus the flat fact that Coraline Ash is an apprentice, so both the decision and her new status are queryable.
good. one assignment event with the Council acting, Coraline Ash transferred and Pell as the recipient; 'the apprentice Coraline Ash' reuses the same person symbol rather than minting a new one.
good. parses as a past-wrapped age measure on Pell, so 'how old was Pell?' binds directly.
